name: Rise | 200mg Tablets | THCA
description:
This THCA-only formulation is skillfully balanced with a blend of terpenes and designed to provide a feeling of mental clarity and overall positive well-being without the euphoria associated with THC.

Key Benefits

Reduces inflammation

Manages muscle spasms symptoms

Relieves pain symptoms

Provides neuroprotection

• 10mg THCA per tablet 

• Natural terpene blend

• Sugar-Free, Dye-Free, Gluten-Free, Vegan

Start with one tablet or easily break and consume half (5mg) dose to manage your symptoms effectively. Swallow, do not chew. After 45 minutes, adjust the dosage until relief is achieved.

Use alone or in combination with other RISE tablet formulations to manage your symptoms effectively.
